title: The Goncharov Lie coalgebra of a field
summary: This paper relates algebraic $K$-theory of fields to polylogarithms via general linear groups. We introduce the Goncharov Lie coalgebra, defined in terms of the $E_\infty$-homology of general linear groups. Using Steinberg modules, we find a presentation, compute its Lie cobracket, and construct motivic and Hodge realisations.
